caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a wooden cylindrical vessel or container, positioned upright on a plain, light beige background. The vessel is medium brown in color with darker and lighter shades indicating the texture and grain of the aged wood. There are visible cracks, knots, and intricate details showing the rough, weathered surface and ring patterns of the wood. The container has a thicker rim at the top, and the sides taper slightly inward toward the bottom. There is no additional ornamentation or objects in the composition, and the overall rendering is realistic, focusing on the texture and form of the wooden object. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the image in a light brown color.
title: Lead Miner's Wooden Bucket
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
